interruption_finding.contract_reason: InitializationOutput explicitly distinguishes planned from created. Proposed profile/artifact hashes are computed from the validated plan bytes before publication. Interruption preserves those dispositions; the service deliberately returns non-directory rows with real planned or committed digests and reports directory effects in counters. Thus a planned digest does not claim a file was created or confer completion authority.

source_references.fact: InitializationOutput supports planned/created/skipped/conflict; InitializationResult reports partial effects without a completion receipt.
Profile and ordinary artifact digests hash their exact proposed bytes; directory rows have no digest.
Bootstrap effects update created/conflict statuses; failed bootstrap preserves all other planned dispositions.
File artifact rows accept real planned/committed digests, directories are counted by disposition, and an unsuccessful initialization returns exit 3 with fixed effect findings.
ServiceArtifact explicitly supports planned status without authorizing an effect; directory/uncertain effects must not receive fabricated file rows.
Success must agree with exit code/findings; output-bearing failures require actual runtime/input context.
Profile ancestors may be created before exclusive profile publication.
The injected fail_publish error occurs before the memory target file is stored.
The direct publication path owns and cleans its temporary stage on failed publication.
Preserve exact partial effects, distinguish artifact status including planned, and never report partial writes as success.
